verdict.rationale: A government online company-incorporation service could plausibly publish an API and a machine-readable spec, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes only a web portal with citizen-card or mobile-key authentication, form-based submission and email notifications. Nothing mentions an API, an OpenAPI document or any other downloadable machine-readable specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
